notes.title: 0.9 Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Updates[/b][/h2]

• Fractional EXP's have been removed
• Tetra damage increased from 1000 to 5000
• Antonius & Bemosyne Boss debuff
• Supreme Skeleton Mini Boss debuff
• Cave health buff range increased
• Cave health upgrade's provided health increased
• Save Sound Settings
• Centaur Collision modified

[h2][b]BUGFIX[/b][/h2]

• Fixed the duration of timed cards
• "Click Anywhere" phrase on the login map integrated into other languages
• Fixed language selection in Training Mode
• Fixed mushrooms not going to Inventory when collected
• Fixed health not decreasing when bosses disappear in the Soulless Temple: Protect the Soul map
• Fixed some bosses not taking damage from Tetra
• Fixed mouse disappearing when pressing ESC on the exit screen to menu

[h2][b]1.0 FULL VERSION[/b][/h2]
[b]The 1.0 Full Version release is just a few days away. Some of the new features coming in the full version include:[/b]

• New Menu map
• New Starting map
• Innovations to reduce file size
• New Traps
• +15 New Languages;

• Simplified Chinese
• Traditional Chinese
• Japanese
• French
• German
• Russian
• Castilian Spanish
• Thai
• Korean
• Polish
• Brazilian Portuguese
• Hungarian
• Czech
• Swedish
• Ukrainian

And more...

[b]We plan to release the Full Version at the Tower Defense Festival.[/b]

notes.title: 0.8 Update
notes.content:
h2][b]Additions/b][/h2]

• Antonius & Bemosyne Boss nerf
• New Musics
• Centaur Customization Section
• Map Selection Screen Background
• End of Wave Cards
• Difficulty Setting

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

• Soulless Temple: Bosses health not decreasing in the Protect the Soul map
• Spear stopping when using the Soul ability
• Having to press twice to reactivate the spear after using the Soul ability
• Fixed crash on the 2nd map
• Character not attacking when setting a trap

[h2][b]Difficulty Setting[/b][/h2]

With the new Difficulty Setting, you can now play in Easy, Normal, Hard, and Very Hard modes.
Each difficulty has different enemy health, damage, speed, and XP.

[h2][b]Wave End Cards[/b][/h2]

Starting from the second wave, you will be presented with 3 cards at the end of each wave level. You can choose one of the 3 cards to receive a reward.

notes.title: 0.7 Update

• A tooltip for shortcut keys
• Game time now starts with 2 digits
• Adjustments to the tutorial mode

• Changed the exit button in the game
• Changed the level-up button for Centaur
• New Basic Attack Animation
• New Achievement
• Changes to the Map section in the menu
• Added new Footstep Sounds

• Changes to the Market system
• Barricade level system
• Barricade health system

[h2][b]BugFix[/b][/h2]

• Time not running when the interface is closed
• Market opening twice when pressed
• Other abilities not usable after using Light Spirit
• Screen sliding
• Icons in the Chest Opening section
• End of match reward icons
• Market opening when obtaining the Card item in the Defend Treasure map

notes.title: Details of The Upcoming 0.7 Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Additions[/b][/h2]

• Shortcut Info Screen
• Starting seconds with two digits
• Entry to Training Mode has become mandatory
• Collecting the Magical Mushroom from the map
• New Market Arrangement
• Prompt to Confirm Exiting the Game
• Fixed issue where using the Light Spirit feature would not increase the cooldown time of other features
• Fixed sound of Centaur level-up button
• Updated information in the Training Area
• Changed level-up button in the Market
• Fixed issue where time would not progress when interface was closed
• Fixed issue where pressing "Tab" twice would open the Market
• Fixed screen shifting when changing resolution
• Fixed old gold icon in the Chest Opening location
• In Almoral Castle: Defend the Treasure map, fixed issue where Market and settings would not open in the Item Card selection section
• Fixed issue where some achievements were not being received

[h2][b]Barricade Additions/b][/h2]

• Barricade health system
• Barricade level system
• Barricade modifications for each level

Barricades now have specific health points based on their levels. As you level up, Barricades change, increasing their health by 1000. You can increase them up to 3 levels.

[h3][b]Newly Supported Languages:[/b][/h3]

Castle Guardian will launch with 15 new languages alongside a total of 17 languages in the 1.0 Full Version release. We are putting extensive effort into supporting additional languages. We aim to make our game available in other languages as well.

notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

• 20 Magical Mushrooms from the start
• No winning points after winning a match
• Problems with graphics settings
• Still moving the screen with the mouse when pausing the game

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:
[b]Added to the menu section:[/b]

• Strategy and Points category added
• Camera angle increased
• Fixed the trace error on the wall
• Texts that were shifted or left off the screen have been fixed.
• The font in which the game name was written was changed

[b]Added to the Capsule Opening section:[/b]

• Added chest opening instead of capsule machine
• To open a chest, you need to buy Magic Mushrooms, not coins
• Added a special animated map instead of opening chests
• Getting Magic Mushrooms now costs 50 Gold
• Magical Mushroom is now available in the menu in the store

[b]New Map:[/b]

• New Main Boss: Black Death Dragon
• New Mini Boss: Griffon
• New Market section
• New Market items
• Tougher enemy armies
• Tougher Boss
• Almoral Castle mission map

[b]Other Additions:[/b]

• When the Mini Boss and Main Boss spawn on the map you are playing on, an information box about the Boss will appear on the left.
• Reduced number of Bomber Skeletons on other maps
• Bomber Skeleton health increased to 250
• Bomber Skeleton movement speed reduced from 600 to 550
• Not all maps will be open anymore. You can finish previous maps and unlock other maps
• New feature icons added
• Correction has been made regarding images in the feature section
• Correction of images in training mode has been made
• Music volume adjustment added to settings
• New achievement added.

notes.title: Future 0.2 Update: Detailed Information
notes.content:
[h2]What will be added to the menu section:[/h2]

• Strategy and Points category will be added
• Camera angle will increase
• The trace error on the wall will be corrected
• Texts that have shifted or come off the screen will be corrected.

[h2]What will be added to the Capsule Opening section:[/h2]

• Crate opening will be added instead of the capsule machine
• To open the chest, you will need to buy Magic Mushrooms, not jetons
• A special animated map will be added instead of opening chests
• Getting Magic Mushroom will cost 50 Gold
• Magical Mushroom can be purchased from the store in the Menu

[h2]New Map:[/h2]

• New Main Boss: Black Death Dragon
• New Mini Boss: Griffon
• New Market section
• New Market items
• Tougher enemy armies
• Tougher Boss
• Almoral Castle mission map

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577997/2aa8e00b23402b8ebfa9b232b8d3df7aaeefccb8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577997/7a828e694df67c57159aac194ebd3d9596fbad43.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44577997/616b40d2ae67c204a157908f4a92f0781a338162.png[/img]


[h2]Other Plugins:[/h2]

• When the Mini Boss and Main Boss appear on the map you are playing on, an information box about the Boss will appear on the left.

• The number of Bomber Skeletons will be reduced on other maps.

• Not all maps will be open anymore. You can finish previous maps and unlock other maps.

[h2]IMPORTANT![/h2]

• It is not planned to adjust the difficulty of the game. Mods such as HARDCORE can be introduced. However, there will be no setting to make the game easier. For those who have difficulty with the game, the Strategy and Points category has been added to the Menu section of the game. There are recommendations there to help you play the game well.

• Character DLCs will not be added in this update. It will be available for purchase on Steam in the next update.
